title: A community app makes the opposite image
summary:
A community app flips image prompts on their heads, while Enter's tier controls and generation authentication get a closer look.

Ankit Anand added the Opposite Prompt Generator, and a follow-up added it to the Hacktoberfest showcase. It turns an image prompt into a short semantic opposite, generates an image from that prompt, and lets users copy the prompt or image URL and download the result.

Enter added a dashboard panel showing assigned tiers and a checkout path for users assigned Seed, Flower or Nectar. A follow-up removed an inaccurate refill countdown and disabled Pollen top-up buttons that would otherwise lead to checkout.

Enter's generation routes now accept either a session cookie or a Bearer API key, while tier and Polar routes remain session-only. Chat completions can omit `model` or use an empty `messages` array; `/api/generate/openai` is the generation route, replacing the removed `/openai/chat/completions` alias.

highlights.title: Generate the opposite image
highlights.text: Give the Opposite Prompt Generator an image idea and it turns the prompt into a semantic opposite, then generates an image. Copy the new prompt or image URL, or download the result.
